name: Bandarion Keep

angles.text: As a paladin, you find Bandarion Keep under Danitha's care. Her fellow paladins hold its walls as a holy bastion against dark forces in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.answer: Leonid Barthalomew commands the Argent Dawn. He once used Bandarion Keep as a base during Scourge incursions into Tirisfal Glades. Now he has returned to meet Danitha and her paladins.

In western Tirisfal Glades, Bandarion Keep is a fortress the Argent Dawn once held against Scourge assaults. The order withdrew to the Plaguelands and left the fort in disrepair. Danitha's paladins restored it and now hold it.

Danitha is a paladin who took stewardship of Bandarion Keep with her order after the Argent Dawn withdrew east to the Plaguelands. She named the keep for a mutual friend she shared with Leonid Barthalomew.

aliases: why was it named bandarion keep
faq.answer: Danitha named the fortress for a mutual friend known to her and Commander Leonid Barthalomew.
faq.q: Why is it called Bandarion Keep?

faq.answer: The Argent Dawn journeys to Bandarion Keep to coordinate with Danitha's paladins. Together they guard against Scourge forces and Cult of the Damned activity across Tirisfal Glades.
faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn interested in Bandarion Keep?

aliases: what happened to the keep after the war
why did argent dawn leave bandarion keep
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn left Bandarion Keep when it shifted its main forces east to battle the Scourge in the Plaguelands. The fort stood empty until Danitha and her paladins took it in hand.
faq.q: Why did the Argent Dawn previously abandon the keep?

sections.body: After you aid the Argent Dawn against Cult of the Damned activity, you are sent northwest across Tirisfal Glades. Commander Leonid Barthalomew waits at the fortress to speak with you about the order's ongoing crusade against darkness.
sections.title: A Summons to the Keep

sections.body: The Argent Dawn once used the stronghold as a staging post against Scourge incursions across Tirisfal Glades. Then the order turned its focus to the Eastern and Western Plaguelands. The fort was left behind and began to decay, until Paladin Danitha and her companions took stewardship of its walls.
sections.title: History and Stewardship

sections.body: Leonid Barthalomew remembers the battles fought from the fortress ramparts. He is relieved the stronghold has not fallen into neglect. Danitha named it for a mutual friend.
sections.title: Memories of a Mutual Friend

summary: At Bandarion Keep, Commander Leonid Barthalomew waits for travelers in western Tirisfal Glades. The Argent Dawn once held the secluded fortress against the Scourge, and Danitha and her paladins now guard its walls.
